name: expose-cloudflare-tunnel
title: Cloudflare Tunnel: a public HTTPS URL for a server project, only the paths you list
description: A public HTTPS URL for a server project by a Cloudflare Tunnel: `pikit expose` makes the tunnel, its routes and its DNS record on your Cloudflare domain, and `pikit up` runs cloudflared beside the app; only the paths you list are public.

expose.description: Make or check the public URL (Cloudflare Tunnel): expose, expose status, expose quick [port], expose delete

environment.name: CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_HOSTNAME
environment.description: The public hostname, on a domain of your Cloudflare account (bot.example.com): `pikit expose` points it at the tunnel.

environment.name: PIKIT_EXPOSE_PATHS
environment.description: The paths the internet may reach, separated by commas: your webhook channels' (/googlechat), a prefix as /hooks/*. /health is always public; anything else answers 404. /admin/* only if you accept that its token is then its only lock.
